watches.name: ChangeMaker FFB 23 Limited Edition
watches.description: Learn more about the ChangeMaker here . Limited and numbered to 500 pieces, the ChangeMaker celebrates our partnership launch with Foundation Fighting Blindness, to recognize the incredible champions of change, who have worked tirelessly to positively impact our collective inclusion journey, and we'll be donating $100 USD per unit to help their cause. Fulfilment on November 3rd. The ChangeMaker features a matte slate-blue titanium case with silver mirrored markers. The case back features a raised relief year-mark and Eone logo; with respective braille alongside each character. The ink-blue Italian leather strap features blue stitching and a standard pin-buckle operation. The new slate-blue is a nod to the Foundation's brand color and values; trust, unity, and importance. <break> Details The Bradley timepiece features raised markers that allow you to feel the time by touch: a triangular marker for twelve, elongated line segments for three, six, and nine, and shorter line segments for the other markers.
